[Verse 1]
I left the harbor before dawn,
With a map folded in my coat.
The old pier thinned behind me,
And salt wind filled the sail.
I kept your words beside my compass,
Though the needle shook and turned;
Each mile taught my hands to steady,
Each tide showed what I’d learned.
[Pre-Chorus]
When the clouds erased the coastline,
And the water rose up wide,
I held fast to what was living
In the small light I carried inside.
[Chorus]
The ocean will kiss my feet,
When this long road meets the sea.
I have crossed through changing weather,
I have become who I can be.
Every mile has left its meaning,
Every wave has made me brave.
I’ll keep sailing toward the morning,
With my heart beyond the waves.
[Verse 2]
There were nights the mast was groaning,
There were days the stores ran low.
I learned the names of quiet courage
From the hands that helped me row.
Some I loved were bound for other shores,
Some I had to leave behind;
Still their kindness crossed the distance,
Like a harbor in my mind.
[Rap-leaning Passage]
I took the wrong turn, read the clouds wrong,
Held my breath when the squall came on.
Lost a little, kept moving ahead,
Kept your promise close when the fear spoke loud.
No straight line, no easy chart,
Just a stubborn hope and a weathered heart.
Every season changed the view;
I found my way by carrying you.
[Pre-Chorus]
When the clouds erased the coastline,
And the water rose up wide,
I held fast to what was living
In the small light I carried inside.
[Chorus]
The ocean will kiss my feet,
When this long road meets the sea.
I have crossed through changing weather,
I have become who I can be.
Every mile has left its meaning,
Every wave has made me brave.
I’ll keep sailing toward the morning,
With my heart beyond the waves.
[Bridge]
If the shore is still a distance,
I won’t turn the vessel round.
There is grace in every crossing,
There is solid earth to be found.
And the voices of the ones I love
Still travel with the tide;
I can feel the welcome waiting
On the far and faithful side.
[Final Chorus]
The ocean will kiss my feet,
When this long road meets the sea.
I have crossed through changing weather,
I have become who I can be.
Every mile has left its meaning,
Every wave has made me brave.
I’ll keep sailing toward the morning,
With my heart beyond the waves.
[Outro]
When the ocean meets my feet,
I’ll know the miles were carrying me.
